origin: all shell, module, frame, Wasm, AVM, and worker requests are same-origin

transport.development: HTTP localhost is a browser-recognized secure context
transport.test: controlled HTTP localhost with exact browser and Phoenix profile
transport.release: HTTPS is required; production support is not claimed
transport.reverse_proxy_cdn: must preserve every declared header, MIME, range, cache, and byte identity; unverified in BH-01

required_response_headers.content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' blob: 'unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

cache.immutable_assets: public, max-age=31536000, immutable with strong SHA-256 ETag
cache.stale_manifest: activation fetches with cache=no-store and rejects identity, URL, byte-count, and digest drift

range: single byte ranges are supported; invalid or multiple ranges return 416
compression: identity artifacts are canonical in BH-01; precompressed deployment remains unverified
cors: no cross-origin access-control headers; same-origin only
integrity: the runtime manifest declares exact bytes and SHA-256 for runtime module, Wasm, and AVM
source_maps: none are emitted for the Phase 4 feasibility loader
rollback: publish a complete immutable asset set before atomically replacing the no-store manifest; retain the prior set until rollback expiry
security_debt: Popcorn 0.3.3 uses runtime evaluation for its Wasm bridge, requiring unsafe-eval in this feasibility CSP
unsupported: service-worker or CDN mutation not proven by profile verification
